title: Normalized strict quotient realization of completed open pullback
statement: Fix l,E and an open immersion j:U→X of schemes. The fixed ordinary ringed pullback and the published integral completed pullback admit Pull l E j of [def-sf-pull-completion-comparison]: good representatives pull back to good representatives; quotient tensors form one natural isomorphism of strict towers, with the prescribed pure-generator formula; and its signed Roos localization is the actual completed comparison, with precisely the representative equation in Pull.model. This has no extension, completeness-preservation or constructibility conclusion.

source.place: Base-change paragraph, open factor; normalization of the completed open operations and their unit equations.

proof.text: Apply integralRingedPullCompletion to j. It constructs exactly Pull l E j for every scheme morphism: its source-good and good fields, strict tower isomorphism, prescribed generator identity, and localized comparison with the representative model equation are the fields required here. Specialization to the given open immersion needs no further argument or choices. The general construction covers identity and empty opens and zero representatives as well.

proof_origin.note: Specialize the existing, fully proved integralRingedPullCompletion theorem. This reuses its normalized quotient tower and localization construction without changing the unit route or the Pull definition.
